about: deploys' application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws, tests and CLI case, not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: dp-status-not-named
mutants.rule: A deploy's body names its status ("pending", "approved"), as std json writes DeployBody.

mutants.name: dp-problem-field-always
mutants.rule: An error's body has "field" only when the failure names one (json.Optional absent).

mutants.name: dp-list-drops-deploys
mutants.rule: GET /deploys lists every deploy's body, in order.

mutants.name: dp-respond-not-json
mutants.rule: Every response body is JSON text (law EveryRequestHasAStatus).

mutants.name: dp-create-taken-is-invalid
mutants.to:
taken = t.ID
			return Invalid{Field: "id", Reason: "the store already holds \(taken)"}
mutants.rule: Create takes the next ID when two creates at once named one: a valid draft is never refused because another create took its ID (memory TwoCreatesAtOnceBothLand, explore leg).
